scene: The glowing blueprint highlights three museum exits to the wider city.
picture: A flat side view of the museum terminal. Far left, a glass pneumatic tube pod sits open in a brass dock. Left of centre stands the Pacific Islander girl holding her sketchbook, looking ahead. Centre hovers the spherical guard robot. Up high floats a tethered bubble lift. Far right sits a painted tram.
shown: a glass pneumatic pod waiting in an open suction gate at far left
a floating iridescent sphere tethered beside the gallery ceiling up high
a rainbow-splashed tram idling through open loading doors at far right
